verdict.rationale: AFK's marketing page claims encrypted secrets and scoped OAuth tokens with rotation and audit logs (afk-docs-9), plus shared company context and role-based access controls across the team (afk-docs-10). Together these suggest centrally held, team-shared connections under some access control. Nothing explicitly says credentials are shared between team members or that access can be restricted per credential. Missing for 10: explicit per-credential permissions (who can use which connection), documented team sharing of connection credentials, in-depth docs beyond marketing copy, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
